name: tuxee
title: Tuxee
description: A tiny Debian Linux with a browser UI for files and persistent terminals that survive logout. Sign in as root; install whatever you need with apt.

defaultEnv.label: Root password
defaultEnv.description: Password for the `root` account you sign in to Tuxee with, behind Hola's SSO gate. Generated per install. It is applied when the container is created, so a container recreate (upgrade or config change) resets root to this value even if you ran `passwd` inside; change it here instead.
